name: Italy
notes: Italian lift passes are typical 6-day prices for the local area. Getting from Geneva to the Aosta Valley uses the Mont Blanc tunnel (toll).

locations.name: Courmayeur
locations.character: Smart, old mountain town under the Italian side of Mont Blanc. Long lunches, a lively evening street and big off-piste.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h20 through the Mont Blanc tunnel.

park.note: A small park.

expert.note: Big off-piste, with the Skyway cable car to the Vallée Blanche and Toula glacier.

locations.name: La Thuile
locations.character: Quiet old mining village with a modern ski-in base, sharing its ski area with La Rosière in France.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h40 through the Mont Blanc tunnel.

links.note: Ski across the Petit-Saint-Bernard to La Rosière

park.note: A small park. La Rosière's park is on the same pass.

expert.note: Good off-piste and heli-skiing from the Rutor glacier.

locations.name: Pila
locations.easyStart: Beginner slopes beside the apartments at the top of the cable car.
locations.character: Sunny, purpose-built resort high above Aosta, reached by an 18-minute cable car from the city.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h. Train to Aosta, then the cable car up.

park.note: A well-known park with lines for beginners and improvers.

expert.note: Some off-piste with views of Mont Blanc and the Matterhorn.

locations.name: Cervinia
locations.easyStart: Wide, gentle slopes right above the village.
locations.snowNote: Glacier skiing up to 3,480 m keeps snow all season.
locations.character: High, snow-sure resort under the Matterhorn with long, easy runs and a ski link over the glacier to Zermatt.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h20. Train to Châtillon, then the bus up.

links.note: Ski over the Plateau Rosa glacier to Zermatt, on an international pass
Ski down to Valtournenche

park.note: A proper park with lines for each level.

expert.note: High off-piste and a glacier link to Zermatt.

locations.name: Valtournenche
locations.character: Real village below Cervinia, with lower prices and lifts up into the same ski area.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h10. Train to Châtillon, then the bus.

links.note: Lifts up to Cervinia

park.note: Small fun zones. Cervinia has the park.

expert.note: Long red runs, with Cervinia's high terrain above.

locations.name: Champoluc
locations.character: Pretty old village in the Ayas valley, the western gate to the Monterosa ski area and its famous off-piste.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h20. Car up the Ayas valley from Verrès.

links.note: Lifts over the Colle Bettaforca

park.note: A small park.

expert.note: Some of the best off-piste in the Alps, best with a guide.

locations.name: Gressoney-La-Trinité
locations.character: Quiet Walser village of stone and wood in the middle of the Monterosa ski area.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h30. Car up the Gressoney valley from Pont-Saint-Martin.

links.note: Lifts over the Passo dei Salati
Lifts over the Colle Bettaforca

park.note: A small park.

expert.note: Big off-piste towards Alagna and Champoluc.

locations.name: Alagna
locations.character: Small Walser village famous with freeriders, at the eastern end of the Monterosa ski area.
locations.transfer: Car about 2h from Milan Malpensa.

links.note: Lifts over the Passo dei Salati

park.note: No park. Alagna is about off-piste.

expert.note: Legendary freeride terrain from Punta Indren, best with a guide.

locations.name: Sestriere
locations.character: High, purpose-built Olympic resort at the heart of the Milky Way. Snow-sure, with skiing from the door.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h30 from Turin. Train to Oulx, then the bus.

links.note: Ski across towards Sansicario

park.note: A proper park with lines for each level.

expert.note: Steep Olympic runs and good off-piste.

locations.name: Sauze d'Oulx
locations.character: Old village with a famous party scene, long a British favourite, with tree-lined runs into the Milky Way.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h15 from Turin. Train to Oulx, then the bus.

links.note: Lifts across to Sestriere

park.note: A proper park with a beginner line.

expert.note: Tree runs and some off-piste.

locations.name: Sansicario
locations.character: Small, quiet ski-in ski-out spot in the middle of the Milky Way.
locations.transfer: Car about 1h20 from Turin.

links.note: Lifts across to Claviere and Montgenèvre

park.note: A small fun zone.

expert.note: Some steeper runs and off-piste.

locations.name: Claviere
locations.character: Tiny border village a short walk from Montgenèvre, with lower Italian prices.
locations.transfer: Car about 1h20 from Turin.

links.note: Ski across the border to Montgenèvre

park.note: Small fun zones. Montgenèvre has the park.

expert.note: Some off-piste towards Cesana.

locations.name: Bardonecchia
locations.character: Real mountain town with a train station, three separate ski areas and good prices.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h15 from Turin. Train to the town.

park.note: A well-known park with lines for each level.

expert.note: Some steeper runs and off-piste.

locations.name: Livigno
locations.easyStart: Nursery slopes along the valley floor, a short walk from most hotels.
locations.character: Long, high valley town with tax-free shopping and snow-sure skiing on both sides. Host of Olympic freestyle events.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 3h30 from Bergamo.

park.note: Mottolino park is one of the best in Europe, with lines for every level and a halfpipe.

expert.note: Some off-piste and steeper runs.

locations.name: Bormio
locations.character: Old Roman spa town with thermal baths and the steep Stelvio World Cup downhill.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 3h from Bergamo.

links.note: Free ski bus up the Valfurva

park.note: A small park.

expert.note: The steep Stelvio run and long off-piste descents.

locations.name: Santa Caterina
locations.character: Small, quiet, snow-sure village at the end of the Valfurva, on the Bormio lift pass.
locations.transfer: Car about 3h15 from Bergamo.

links.note: Ski bus down to Bormio

park.note: A small fun zone.

expert.note: Some steeper runs and off-piste.

locations.name: Madesimo
locations.character: Quiet village near the Swiss border, with the famous Canalone off-piste run.
locations.transfer: Car about 2h15 from Bergamo or Milan.

park.note: A small park.

expert.note: The steep Canalone and good off-piste.

locations.name: Aosta
locations.character: Roman city with an old town, real shops and everyday prices. A cable car climbs from the station area to Pila.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h45 from Geneva through the Mont Blanc tunnel.

links.note: Cable car straight up to Pila

locations.name: Pré-Saint-Didier
locations.character: Small village with famous thermal baths, between Courmayeur and La Thuile.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h30 from Geneva.

locations.name: Morgex
locations.character: Quiet wine village below Courmayeur, with lower prices.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h30 from Geneva.

locations.name: Châtillon
locations.character: Valley town with a train station and buses up to Cervinia.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h from Geneva.

locations.name: Pont-Saint-Martin
locations.character: Small town with a Roman bridge at the mouth of the Gressoney valley.
locations.transfer: Car about 1h45 from Milan Malpensa or Turin.

locations.name: Oulx
locations.character: Small town with the main station of the Milky Way, where the Paris to Milan TGV stops.
locations.transfer: Train from Turin about 1h. Car 1h.

locations.name: Susa
locations.character: Old Roman town lower down the valley, with low prices and trains to Turin.
locations.transfer: Train from Turin about 1h. Car 50 min.

locations.name: Tirano
locations.character: Valley town where the Bernina Express starts, with lower prices than Bormio and Livigno.
locations.transfer: Train from Milan about 2h30. Car from Bergamo 2h30.

locations.name: Cortina d'Ampezzo
locations.character: Elegant mountain town in a bowl of pale peaks, the Queen of the Dolomites. Smart shops, a busy evening walk and a 2026 Winter Olympics host.
locations.transfer: Cortina Express bus from Venice Airport about 2h. From Verona Airport about 3h30 by car.

park.note: A small park and some fun zones.

expert.note: Steep Tofana runs, the Staunies and Lagazuoi, with guided off-piste.

locations.name: Ortisei
locations.character: Pretty, car-light Ladin town with wood carvers and a pedestrian centre. Gondolas leave right from the village to Seceda and Alpe di Siusi.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h30 from Verona Airport. About 3h15 from Venice Airport.

links.note: Cable car up to the Alpe di Siusi meadows
Ski bus up the valley, or the lifts and pistes

park.note: A small park and fun zones above Seceda.

expert.note: Seceda and Sella Ronda runs, with guided itineraries nearby.

locations.name: Selva di Val Gardena
locations.easyStart: Nursery slopes in the village, a short walk from most hotels.
locations.character: Livelier village at the top of Val Gardena, with the Saslong World Cup downhill and the start of the Sella Ronda in either direction.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h45 from Verona Airport. About 3h15 from Venice Airport.

links.note: Sella Ronda by lift, over the Gardena pass

park.note: A small park and fun zones.

expert.note: The Saslong run, Sassolungo off-piste and the Sella itineraries.

locations.name: Corvara
locations.easyStart: Nursery slopes by the village centre and the Col Alto gondola.
locations.character: Small, smart village in the middle of the Sella Ronda, with the Boè cable car and skiing from the door.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 3h from Verona Airport. About 3h from Venice Airport.

links.note: Ski over the Campolongo pass to Arabba on the Sella Ronda
Lifts down the Alta Badia valley

park.note: Fun zones and a small park.

expert.note: The Gardenaccia and Boè descents, and the steep Sella itineraries.

locations.name: La Villa
locations.character: Quiet Alta Badia village with fine restaurants. Home of the Gran Risa giant slalom, with the Stria slopes beside it.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 3h from Verona Airport. About 3h from Venice Airport.

park.note: A fun zone and small kickers.

expert.note: The Gran Risa and Lagazuoi runs. Fine off-piste with a guide.

locations.name: Arabba
locations.character: Small high-up village with steep runs on Porta Vescovo and the Marmolada glacier nearby. A skier's base rather than a party town.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 3h from Verona Airport. About 2h45 from Venice Airport.

links.note: Ski over the Pordoi pass to Canazei
Ski over the Campolongo pass to Corvara

park.note: No park. Arabba is about steep runs and the Sella Ronda.

expert.note: Porta Vescovo, the Sass Pordoi couloirs and the Marmolada. Big steeps in every direction.

locations.name: Canazei
locations.character: The main village of Val di Fassa, with a lively street, plenty of hotels and lifts to the Sella Ronda and Pordoi pass.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h30 from Verona Airport. About 3h15 from Venice Airport.

links.note: Sella Ronda by lift via the Sella pass

park.note: A small park.

expert.note: The Sass Pordoi runs and off-piste, with the Val Lasties itinerary.

locations.name: Alpe di Siusi
locations.easyStart: Wide, easy slopes right beside the Compatsch hotels.
locations.character: Europe's biggest high alpine meadow, wide and gentle, with the Sassolungo peaks and the Sciliar as a backdrop. Few hotels and no cars on the plateau in the day.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h30 from Verona Airport to Siusi, then the cable car. About 3h30 from Venice Airport.

park.note: A small park and kids' fun zone.

expert.note: Mostly gentle, sunny slopes. Not for steeps.

locations.name: Kronplatz
locations.character: Round, sunny hill above Riscone and Brunico, with gondolas from several sides and one of the best snow records in the Dolomites. Reached on foot from the Brunico side.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h45 from Verona Airport. About 3h from Venice Airport.

park.note: A well-known park with lines for each level.

expert.note: Steep black runs and some off-piste.

locations.name: Madonna di Campiglio
locations.character: Stylish resort in the Brenta Dolomites, with a famous night slalom and smart evenings. Links by gondola to Pinzolo and Folgarida-Marilleva.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h30 from Verona Airport. About 3h30 from Venice Airport.

park.note: A proper park with lines for each level.

expert.note: The steep 3-Tre World Cup slalom and Grostè off-piste.

locations.name: Cavalese
locations.character: Old valley town with a pretty centre and a gondola straight up to Alpe Cermis. Good value for the Dolomites.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h15 from Verona Airport. About 3h from Venice Airport.

park.note: A small park on the Cermis slopes.

expert.note: A steep World Cup black run, not much more.

locations.name: San Martino di Castrozza
locations.character: Sunny village under the Pale di San Martino, the wild side of the Dolomites. Quiet evenings and a cable car to the Rosetta plateau.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 3h from Verona Airport. About 2h45 from Venice Airport.

park.note: A small park.

expert.note: The Rosetta cable car, the Tognola bowl and long off-piste descents.

locations.name: Sesto
locations.easyStart: Beginner slopes beside the Monte Elmo lift in Moos.
locations.character: Quiet village below the Tre Cime di Lavaredo, with sunny pistes and a lot of cross-country trails. Hotels are family run.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 3h30 from Verona Airport. About 3h from Venice Airport.

park.note: No park.

expert.note: Some steeper slopes on Monte Elmo and Croda Rossa.

locations.name: Bolzano
locations.character: Warm, lively South Tyrol city with arcades, markets and a good old town. A base for several Dolomite valleys, not a ski town.
locations.transfer: Train from Verona about 1h45. Car about 1h45 from Verona Airport. About 3h from Venice Airport.

links.note: SAD bus up Val Gardena
SAD bus up Val Gardena
Bus to Siusi, then the Seiser Alm cable car

locations.name: Bressanone
locations.character: Old bishop's town with a fine centre and a spa. Close to Plose and a short trip to several big areas.
locations.transfer: Train from Verona about 2h15. Car about 2h from Verona Airport. About 3h from Venice Airport.

links.note: SAD bus via Chiusa
Train to Brunico, then the Riscone bus

locations.name: Brunico
locations.character: Real town with arcades, shops and a modern gondola that reaches Kronplatz in a few minutes.
locations.transfer: Train from Verona about 3h. Car about 2h40 from Verona Airport. About 3h from Venice Airport.

links.note: Gondola from the Brunico side to Kronplatz
SAD bus over the Furcia and Campolongo road

locations.name: Chiusa
locations.character: Tiny walled town of artists, at the foot of the road to Val Gardena. Cheap and calm.
locations.transfer: Train from Verona about 2h. Car about 2h from Verona Airport.

links.note: SAD bus up the valley

locations.name: Castelrotto
locations.character: Painted little village on a terrace above the valley, with a bell tower and good views. A quiet way into Alpe di Siusi.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h30 from Verona Airport. About 3h30 from Venice Airport.

links.note: Bus to Siusi, then the cable car to Compatsch

locations.name: Predazzo
locations.character: Valley town in Val di Fiemme with real shops and low prices. Handy for Cavalese, San Martino and the Fassa valley.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h from Verona Airport. About 3h from Venice Airport.

links.note: Trentino Trasporti bus down the valley
Bus over the Fassa valley
Over the Rolle pass

locations.name: Pinzolo
locations.character: Valley town with its own small ski area and a gondola link towards Madonna di Campiglio, at much lower prices.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h30 from Verona Airport. About 3h30 from Venice Airport.

links.note: Gondolas from Pinzolo up the Prà Rodont to the Campiglio slopes
Direct bus up the road

locations.name: Pieve di Cadore
locations.character: Cadore hill town, the birthplace of Titian, at much lower prices than Cortina. Trains stop at nearby Calalzo.
locations.transfer: Train from Venice to Calalzo about 2h15, then a short bus. Car about 2h from Venice Airport.

links.note: Cortina Express or local bus

locations.name: Dobbiaco
locations.character: Quiet village at the head of the Pustertal, known for cross-country skiing and flat winter walks. Good for Sesto, Cortina and Kronplatz.
locations.transfer: Train from Verona about 3h30. Car about 3h15 from Verona Airport. About 2h45 from Venice Airport.

links.note: Bus to the Monte Elmo and Croda Rossa lifts
Train to Brunico, then the Riscone bus

locations.name: San Candido
locations.character: Small town at the end of the Pustertal line, with a handsome collegiate church. A cheaper way into Sesto and Cortina.
locations.transfer: Train from Verona about 3h45. Car about 3h20 from Verona Airport.

links.note: Bus up the Sexten valley

locations.name: Moena
locations.character: Pretty Ladin village known as the fairy of the Dolomites, with its own small slopes and good-value stays.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h15 from Verona Airport. About 3h from Venice Airport.

links.note: Bus up Val di Fassa
Over the Valles or Rolle pass
